summary: No unresolved plan findings identified in the supplied plan, specification, verification material and source evidence. DB-R1-01 is addressed at the design level: a durably committed, fenced verification attempt precedes reads and effects; unresolved attempts prevent recovered authority, including after original bytes are restored; recovery requires explicit invalidation and fresh critique/approval. Required compound failure, restart, concurrency and migration tests cover that protocol. The plan also requires an exhaustive approval-consumer inventory and negative tests before completion. This verdict assesses the proposed design only; implementation and test results remain unproven. It grants no owner approval or implementation authority. Delivery remains a feature-branch review PR with human-controlled integration and no automatic merge or pilot execution.
